ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel field covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across both lobes, with a high density of non-contiguous white pixel blobs of varying diameters (mottling) distributed across the central and distal areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex and symmetrical divergence of the proximal lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire visible boundary; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced pixel-level peaks and jagged irregularities compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed and slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular or elliptical high-contrast white pixel clusters ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in diameter, scattered across the dark substrate of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular nicks and jagged indentations along the trailing edge margin, particularly on the right lobe distal boundary.
